documents.markdown:
# Lost Comms (IFR)

> **Approximate Completion Time:** Briefly state how long this takes to do on average
> **Purpose:** Briefly state what this checklist accomplishes and when to use it.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Information essential to successful completion. Add any safety warning, limitation, or governing-document reminder here.

**Owner:** Pablo Martinez 
**Applies to:** IFR
**Revision:** 0.1  
**Last updated:** 2026-08-02  
**Source of truth:** [Document title](https://example.com)

---
### Electric System
- [ ] Alternator Ammeter - Ensure **NO DISCHARGE**

> [!WARNING]
> **If** ammeter shows **discharge** alternator failure is possible. Reduce electrical load. **LAND ASAP**

### Autopilot/ Navigation
- [ ] **Autopilot** (If Available) - **SET** to fly most recent clearance
#### Lateral

| Clearance Type |Fly ...|
|:---:|:---|
| Vectors| Direct from point of comms failure to fix or route assigned by vectors |
| No Assigned Route/ Fix |Route/fix ATC advised may be expected|
| No Expected route/fix |Filed clearance|

#### Vertical/ Altitude
Fly **highest of**:
- Assigned Altitude
- Altitude ATC Advised you to expect
- MEA/MOCA

___

### Radios - Return Point
- [ ] ATC - Tune last known-good frequency
  - [ ] Ask for new frequency

> [!TIP]
> If another aircraft can hear you on the radio, try to use them as a relay to re-establish comms with ATC

- [ ] Alternate Radio - Set last known-good frequency to ACTIVE
  - [ ] Ask for new frequency
- [ ] Chart/ AIRAC/ GPS - Obtain freq. for center/approach
  - [ ] Set ACTIVE COM1/COM2
- [ ] **Flight Service** - **contact** over nearby NAVAID
- [ ] GUARD (121.5 MHz) - Attempt calling
- [ ] **Transponder - SET 7600**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> IF in VMC conditions. You must hereby continue the flight under VFR and land as soon as practical

### Handheld Radio

> [!TIP]
> Place the handheld radio close to the window for best reception

- [ ] **Handheld Radio - Attempt ALL** previous steps **beggining from "Radios - Return Point"**

### If Handheld not working

- [ ] **Transponder - SET 7600**
- [ ] Continue contact attempts on last known-good frequency

---

<!-- flitechek-id: 000010 -->

documents.markdown:
# Cruise

> **Approx. Completion Time:** 2 Minutes
> **Purpose:** Prepare for Approach

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Standard In-Range is able to obtain destination ATIS[^1]

**Owner:** Pablo Martinez
**Applies to:** C172S VFR
**Revision:** 0.1  
**Last updated:** 2026-08-02  
**Source of Truth:** [C172S POH § 4-16](https://www.befa.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/POH-Cessna-172S.pdf)

---

## Canon Checklist
- [ ] **Power** - **2100 - 2700 RPM**
> [!IMPORTANT]
> No more than 75% sustained power is recommended for cruise
- [ ] Elevator **Trim** - **Adjust**/ Trim the aircraft
- [ ] **Mixture** - **LEAN** for altitude

---
## Traffic
- [ ] Sentry **(ADS-B In)** - Ensure **Operational/connected** to iPad
- [ ] Foreflight - Radar (ADS-B) ACTIVE
- [ ] **Traffic** - Ensure **clear** on foreflight


## Navigation

- [ ] **Aircraft** - **Point** to first waypoint
- [ ] **Navigation:**

| Primary Navigation | Action |
|:---:|---|
| GPS | Input flight Plan into FMS |
| VOR/ Ground-Based | Input All VOR Frequescies into NAV1 + 2 |

---

## Communications
- [ ] Next Frequency - SET on Standby on COM1
- [ ] Guard - Set active on COM2

<!-- flitechek-id: 000006 -->

documents.name: 2. In-Flight/B. Descent.md
documents.markdown:
# Descent

> **Approx. Completion Time:** 2 Minutes
> **Purpose:** Prepare for Approach

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Complete to initiate descent

**Owner:** Pablo Martinez
**Applies to:** C172S VFR
**Revision:** 0.1  
**Last updated:** 2026-08-02  
**Source of Truth:** [C172S POH § 4-16](https://www.befa.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/POH-Cessna-172S.pdf)

---
## Canon Checklist
> [!Caution]
> **Disconnect Autopilot** before reducing power otherwise you will slow down instead of descending
- [ ] **Power** - Set **AS DESIRED** to achieve smooth descent
- [ ] **Mixture** - **Adjust** for smooth operation (full rich for idle Power)
- [ ] **Altimeter** - **Set**/crosscheck
- [ ] **NAV/GPS** Switch - **SET**
- [ ] **Fuel Selector Valve** - **BOTH**
- [ ] Wing **Flaps** - AS DESIRED (**Vs1 - 110 KIAS, Vs2-3 85 KIAS**)

documents.name: 2. In-Flight/C. In-Range (VFR).md
documents.markdown:
# In-Range Checklist

>**Approx Completion Time**: 10 Mins
> **Purpose:** Lighten the load on final landing and approach checklists

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Standard In-Range is able to obtain destination ATIS[^1]

[^1]:The range of ATIS capture may vary from 20 NM to 60 NM.

**Owner:** Pablo Martinez 
**Applies to:** ASEL VFR
**Revision:** 0.2  
**Last updated:** 2026-08-02

---

## Main Checklist

### Configuration

- [ ] **Autopilot** — Set if possible

#### Fuel Tanks

| Fuel Tank Type | Then take this action... | Condition |
|---|---|:---:|
| Selectable | Select fullest and set tank-switch timer | Monitor Timer|
| Both can be selected | Set/Ensure set to "Both" | Cross-Check |
| Unable to set "Both" | Select Fullest and calculate endurance. Advise other pilot of endurance | Warning |

- [ ] **Nav Lights** — Set
- [ ] **Strobes** — Set
- [ ] **Exterior Lights** — Set
- [ ] **Pressurization** — Set

### Communication

- [ ] **Destination Tower/ CTAF** — Set on **ACTIVE COM1 (monitor)**
- [ ] **Destination ATIS** — Set on  **ACTIVE COM2**
- [ ] **Parachuting/ TFR/ Special Activities** — Check active times on Sectional
  
### Weather

> [!TIP]
> If only a couple of minutes from 56 on the hour, wait until the latest ATIS comes out if possible

- [ ] **Destination ATIS** - Obtain
  - [ ] **Ceilings** — Meet VFR Requirements
  - [ ] **Temp-Dewpoint Spread** — Calculate
  - [ ] **Information Designation** — Obtain
- [ ] **Destination Runway** — Determine/Confirm
- [ ] **Altimeter** — Set as per ATIS

> [!CAUTION]
> If weather are not within minimums personal or otherwise, consider diverting to alternate

___

## Approach Preparation

### Navigation

- [ ] **Approach Briefing** — Complete
- [ ] **Approach Plate** — Pulled Up
- [ ] **Approach** — Load on VLOC/GPS

# ✅ Checklist Complete

---

| Revision | Date | Author | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.1 | 2026-07-31| Initials | Initial draft |

documents.markdown:
# Day Before Checklist

>**Approx Completion Time**: 1 Hr
>
> **Purpose:** Lighten workload on day of of operation
>
> **Important:** Sleep is most important

[^1]:The range of ATIS capture may vary from 20 NM to 60 NM.

**Owner:** Pablo Martinez 
**Applies to:** ASEL IFR
**Revision:** 0.1  
**Last updated:** 2026-08-13  
**Source of truth:** [Federal Aviation Administration. U.S. Terminal Procedures
Publication, [volume], “Supplemental Tables—Rate of Descent
Table,” p. J3, effective Sep 03 2026–Oct 29 2026.](https://www.faa.gov/air_traffic/flight_info/aeronav/digital_products/dtpp/)

---
## Personal Preparation
- [ ] **Curfew** - Determine[^1]
- [ ] **Curfew** - Set Alarm 1 Hr Prior
- [ ] **Hydration/Tea** - Set to steep


[^1]: based on 7 hours of sleep
---
## Equipment Preparation

### Update Software
Ensure all the following databases and applications are up to date
> [!CAUTION]
> Foreflight Databases and application must be up to date on **BOTH iPhone and iPad** 
#### Foreflight
- Foreflight Databases up to date
- Foreflight App up to date



### Put to Charge
Ensure all the following equipment is put to charge
- Garmin InReach
- Battery Bank
- Headlamp/Flashlight
- iPad
- Phone
- Handheld Radio Batteries
  
## Kneeboard
- Pens x 3 → Ensure All working
- Earplugs → In Pocket

## Flight Bag
- USB-B to USB-C Cable
- USB-C to USB-C Cable
- iPad Mount
- Apple Pencil is in iPad Case
- Inspect Headset and place in flight bag
  
## Safety Equipment
### Foreflight Sentry
- Ensure Sentry Connected to Foreflight
- Sentry in Flight Bag
- Sentry Mount in Flight Bag
#### Handheld Radio

#### Other
- Gloves → In flight bag

### Recording Equipment (Optional)
- GoPro → Put to charge
- Go Pro SD Card → Cleared and Re-installed
- Go Pro GA Cable → Put in flight bag

## Documentation

### Legally Required Documentation
Ensure all the folowing documentation is placed in your flight bag
- Medical Certificate
- Government ID
- Pilot Certificate
- POH/AFM
- Logbook

### Reservation
- Ensure Aircraft reservation is accurate

## Flight Planning
### Foreflight
1. Ensure Route is set in Foreflight "Flights" tab
2. Generate preliminary flight briefing on foreflight

## Approach
- [ ] Obtain climb/descent table [^2]
[^2]: ![FAA climb and descent table](../FAA%20Assets/Climb%20and%20Descent%20Table.png) This will later be converted to an in-checklist calculator

 - [ ] Determine Approx groundspeed
 - [ ] Determine approach glideslope
 - [ ] Determine approx descent rate


# ✅ Checklist Complete

<!-- flitechek-id: 000001 -->

documents.markdown:
# Pre-Flight Inspection

> **Approximate Completion Time:** Briefly state how long this takes to do on average
> **Purpose:** Briefly state what this checklist accomplishes and when to use it.

**Owner:** Pablo Martinez 
**Applies to:** C172R, VFR
**Revision:** 0.1  
**Last updated:** 2026-10-18  
**Source of truth:** [C172S POH § 4-7](https://www.befa.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/POH-Cessna-172S.pdf)

---
## CABIN

 - [ ] Pitot Tube Cover -- REMOVE. Check for pitot blockage.
 - [ ] Pilot's Operating Handbook -- AVAILABLE IN THE AIRPLANE.
 - [ ] Airplane Weight and Balance -- CHECKED.
 - [ ] Control Wheel Lock -- REMOVE.
 - [ ] Ignition Switch -- OFF.
 - [ ] Parking Brake -- SET.
 - [ ] Avionics Master Switch -- OFF.

 > [!WARNING]
 > When turning on the master switch, using an external power source, or pulling the propeller through by hand, **TREAT THE PROPELLER AS IF THE IGNITION SWITCH WERE ON**. Do not stand, nor allow anyone else to stand, within the arc of the propeller, since a loose or broken wire or a component malfunction could cause the propeller to rotate.

 - [ ] Master Switch -- ON.
 - [ ] Fuel Quantity Indicators -- CHECK QUANTITY and ENSURE
LOW FUEL ANNUNCIATORS (L LOW FUEL R) ARE EXTINGUISHED
 - [ ] Avionics Master Switch -- ON.
 - [ ] Avionics Cooling Fan -- LISTEN FOR SOUNDS.
 - [ ] Avionics Master Switch -- OFF.
 - [ ] Static Pressure Alternate Source Valve -- OFF
 - [ ] Annunciator Panel Switch -- HOLD IN TST POSITION and ensure all annunciators illuminate.
 - [ ] Annunciator Panel Test Switch -- RELEASE. Check that appropriate annunciators remain on.

 > [!NOTE]
 > When Master Switch is turned ON, some annunciators will
flash for approximately 10 seconds before illuminating
steadily. When panel TST switch is toggled up and held in
position, all remaining lights will flash until the switch is
released.

 - [ ] Fuel Selector Valve -- SET BOTH.
 - [ ] Fuel Shutoff Valve -- ON (Push Full In).
 - [ ] Flaps -- EXTEND.
 - [ ] Pitot Heat -- ON. (Carefully check that pitot tube is warm to touch within 30 seconds.)
 - [ ] Pitot Heat -- OFF.
 - [ ] Master Switch -- OFF.
 - [ ] Baggage Door -- CHECK, lock with key.
 - [ ] Elevator Trim -- SET for takeoff.
 - [ ] Autopilot Static Source Opening (if installed) -- CHECK for blockage.

## LEFT WING
 - [ ] Fuel Quantity -- CHECK with stick and visually for desired level.
 - [ ] Fuel Filler Cap -- SECURE and VENT UNOBSTRUCTED.
 - [ ] Fuel Tank - SUMP

 ### Leading Edge
 - [ ] Fuel Tank Vent Opening -- CHECK for blockage. I2
 - [ ] Stall Horn Opening -- CHECK for blockage.
   
 > [!TIP]
 > To check the stall horn system, place a clean handkerchief over the vent opening and apply suction; a sound from the warning horn will confirm system operation.
 - [ ] Wing Tie-Down -- DISCONNECT.
 - [ ] Landing/Taxi Light(s) -- CHECK for condition and cleanliness of cover.
 ### Trailing Edge
  - [ ] Aileron-- CHECK for freedom of movement and security
  - [ ] Flap -- CHECK for security and condition.

## Empennage
 - [ ] Rudder Gust Lock (if installed) -- REMOVE.
 - [ ] Tail Tie-Down -- DISCONNECT.
 - [ ] Control Surfaces -- CHECK freedom of movement and
security.
 - [ ] Trim Tab -- CHECK security.
 - [ ] Antennas -- CHECK for security of attachment and general condition.
 - [ ] Baggage Compartment Door - CLOSED and LOCKED

## Right Wing
 - [ ] Wing Tie-Down -- DISCONNECT.
 ### Trailing Edge
 - [ ] Aileron -- CHECK freedom of movement and security.
 - [ ] Flap -- CHECK for security and condition.
 - [ ] Main Wheel Tire -- CHECK for proper inflation and general condition (weather checks, tread depth and wear, etc ... ).


## Wheel & Tires (Cessna 172R (160 HP))

| Specification | Main Wheels | Nose Wheel |
|---|---|---|
| Tire Pressure | 28 PSI | 34 PSI |
| Tire Size | 6.00-6, 4-ply | 5.00-5, 6-ply |
| Minimum Tread Depth | Tread grooves must remain visible | Tread grooves must remain visible |


 - [ ] General Condition - CHECK
 - [ ] Pressure - CHECK
 - [ ] Tread Depth - CHECK


 Fuel Tank - SUMP
 > [!Important]
 > **If water is observed**:
 >  - [ ] Gently rock wings
 >  - [ ] Lower tail to the ground 
 > 
 > Take repeated samples from all fuell drain points until all contamination has been removed. **If contaminants are still present, refer to WARNING below and do not fly airplane.**

 > [!WARNING]
 > **If**, after repeated sampling, **evidence of contamination still exists, the airplane should not be flown**. 
 >
 > **CALL MAINTENANCE, DO NOT FLY AIRPLANE**
 > 
 > Tanks should be drained and system purged by qualified maintenance personnel. All evidence of contamination must be removed before further flight.
 >   
 - [ ] Fuel Quantity -- CHECK with stick and visually
 - [ ] Fuel Filler Cap -- SECURE and VENT UNOBSTRUCTED
   
## NOSE
 - [ ] Fuel Strainer Quick Drain Valve (Located on bottom of fuselage) -- SUMP
 - [ ] Engine Oil -- CHECK oil level
 - [ ] Dipstick/Filler Cap - SECURE. 

 > [!IMPORTANT]
 > **Do not operate with less than five quarts**. Fill to eight quarts for extended flight.

 - [ ] Engine Cooling Air Inlets -- CLEAR of obstructions
 - [ ] Propeller and Spinner -- CHECK for nicks, pitting and damage
 - [ ] Air Filter -- CHECK
 - [ ] Nose Wheel Strut and Tire -- CHECK for proper inflation of strut and general condition (weather checks, tread depth and wear, etc ... ) of tire.
 - [ ] Left Static Source Opening -- CHECK for blockage

<!-- flitechek-id: 000012 -->

# Before Startine Engine

> **Approximate Completion Time:** Briefly state how long this takes to do on average
> **Purpose:** Briefly state what this checklist accomplishes and when to use it.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Information essential to successful completion. Add any safety warning, limitation, or governing-document reminder here.

**Owner:** Pablo Martinez
**Applies to:** C172*, VFR
**Revision:** 0.1  
**Last updated:** 2026-10-12
**Source of truth:** [C172S POH](https://example.com)

---
## Documentation
- [ ] **Tachometer** - Record/ Take Picture
- [ ] **Hobbs Meter** - Record/ Take Picture
- [ ] Preflight Inspection - COMPLETE
## Passenger Briefing
- [ ] Seats and Seatbelts - Adjusted and Locked
- [ ] Airvents and Ventilation Briefing - COMPLETE
- [ ] Fire Extinguisher - Pressure checked and location briefed
- [ ] Egress Briefing - COMPLETE
- [ ] Traffic Briefing - COMPLETE
- [ ] Passenger Questions - ask if they have any

## Equipment
- [ ] Brakes - TEST and SET
- [ ] Circuit Breakers - CHECK IN
- [ ] Electrical Equipment - OFF

> [!CAUTION]
> The **avionics master switch must be off** during engine start to prevent possible damage to avionics

- [ ] Avionics Master Switch - OFF
- [ ] Fuel Selector Valve - BOTH
- [ ] Fuel Shutoff Valve - ON (Push full in)
- [ ] Avionics Circuit Breakers - CHECK IN

documents.name: 5. Ground Ops/Starting Engine (With Battery).md
documents.markdown:
# Starting Engine (With Battery)

> **Approximate Completion Time:** Briefly state how long this takes to do on average
> **Purpose:** Briefly state what this checklist accomplishes and when to use it.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Information essential to successful completion. Add any safety warning, limitation, or governing-document reminder here.

**Owner:** Pablo Martinez 
**Applies to:** C172*, VFR
**Revision:** 0.1  
**Last updated:** 2026-10-12
**Source of truth:** [Document title](https://example.com)

---
- [ ] Throttle - OPEN 1/4 INCH
- [ ] Mixture - IDLE CUTOFF
- [ ] Propeller Area - CLEAR BOTH SIDES
- [ ] Master Switch - ON
- [ ] Flashing Beacon - ON

> [!NOTE]
> if engine is warm, omit priming procedure of steps 6,7 and 8 below

- [ ] Auxillary Fuel Pump Switch - ON
- [ ] Mixture - Set to FULL RICH (Full forward) until stable fuel flwo is indicated (usually 3 to 5 seconds), then set to IDLE CUTOFF (Full aft) position
- [ ] Auxillary Fuel Pumo Switch - OFF
- [ ] Inigition Switch - START (release when engine starts)
- [ ] Mixture - advance smoothly to rich when engine starts

> [!CAUTION]
> if engine floods (engine has been primed too much)
> - [ ] Auxillary Fuel Pump - OFF
> - [ ] Mixture - IDLE CUTOFF
> - [ ] Throttle - 1/2 to FULL OPEN
> - [ ] Ignition - START (Crank Engine)
> 
> Once the engine starts:
>  - [ ] Mixture - FULL RICH
>  - [ ] Throttle - FULL AFT 

- [ ] Oil Pressure - CHECK
- [ ] Navigation Lights - ON as required
- [ ] Avionics Master Switch - ON
- [ ] Radios - ON
- [ ] Flaps - RETRACT
